analyst.summary: Alkem FY26: revenue +13.5% to Rs.14,712cr, EBITDA +19.6% (margin 20.4%), but Q4 PAT fell -22.7% YoY on a disclosed one-off (Rs.135cr exceptional items: real-estate impairment + labour-code liabilities) - stock still rose ~6% on result day on early-Tolvaptan and tax-cut news, i.e. the one-off was read through. Fresh USFDA Form-483 at the Daman (Amaliya) plant, 7 observations (May-2026) - a general formulations site (not biologics/PLI), no warning letter to date. India franchise remains strong: #1 in anti-infectives for 15+ years, chronic-therapy mix-shift underway, and an early, share-gaining semaglutide (GLP-1) launch (~11% domestic share already). Enzene (biosimilars/CDMO subsidiary) added a 4th biosimilar launch in 18 months and an ADVANZ Pharma partnership. Valuation is the caution: ~28.2x TTM P/E, only ~6% upside to 20-analyst consensus target - fairly-to-fully priced, not cheap. Section-232 tariffs currently exempt generics (Alkem's core), 1-year scope-review clause is the residual policy tail risk.
